item.jaymospowers.patron_weapon.hearthgu: Now and then a blow heals you and those near you
The Hearthkeeper's sworn: heals twice as much, farther
item.jaymospowers.patron_weapon.anvil_fa: Each blow strips armour from the struck for a while (up to 3)
item.jaymospowers.patron_weapon.tidecall: Use: drags foes near you in, slowed; farther in water or rain
The Deep Mother's sworn: farther, and sooner again
item.jaymospowers.patron_weapon.huntsman: Marks what it strikes: your blows on it land harder, beasts most
The Green Huntsman's sworn: harder still
item.jaymospowers.patron_weapon.gravelig: Burns the undead it strikes, harder by night
The Lantern Warden's sworn: harder, and each undead struck heals you
item.jaymospowers.patron_weapon.sunbrand: Use: calls the sun down on the foe you look at
The Crowned Sun's sworn: harder, and sooner again
item.jaymospowers.patron_weapon.ashfang: Use: a leap back into smoke, unseen; your next blow cuts deep
The Ash Whisperer's sworn: unseen longer, and sooner again
item.jaymospowers.patron_weapon.plain_wo: Each blow strips a blessing from the struck, and shows the unseen
The Truth's sworn: two at a blow
item.jaymospowers.patron_weapon.cold: Cold in the hands of one who turned from its patron
jei.jaymospowers.patron_head.hearthguard: Taken from the Hearth-Warden, the Hearthkeeper's champion, in a hearth-hall. Sure to fall by your third kill. It can't be cast or forged: put it together at the Tool Station with a Tool Handle and a Tool Binding.
jei.jaymospowers.patron_head.anvil_fathe: Taken from the Forge-Thane, the Anvil-Father's champion, deep underground or in the Nether. Sure to fall by your third kill. Put it together at the Tool Station with a Tough Handle and a Tool Binding.
jei.jaymospowers.patron_head.tidecaller_: Taken from the Tide-Bride, the Deep Mother's champion, at a temple by the sea. Sure to fall by your third kill. Put it together at the Tool Station with a Tool Handle and a Tool Binding.
jei.jaymospowers.patron_head.huntsmans_s: Taken from the Antlered Hunter, the Green Huntsman's champion, in a deep-forest glade. Sure to fall by your third kill. Put it together at the Tool Station with a Tool Handle and a Tool Binding.
jei.jaymospowers.patron_head.gravelight_: Taken from the Grave-Lamp, the Lantern Warden's champion, in a crypt or the Nether's soul valleys. Sure to fall by your third kill. Put it together at the Tool Station with a Tool Handle and a Tool Binding.
jei.jaymospowers.patron_head.sunbrand_bl: Taken from the Sun-Marshal, the Crowned Sun's champion, on high ground or in the Aether. Sure to fall by your third kill. Put it together at the Tool Station with a Crossguard and a Tool Handle.
jei.jaymospowers.patron_head.ashfang_bla: Taken from the Cinder-Shade, the Ash Whisperer's champion, in a hidden hollow or the Nether's deltas. Sure to fall by your third kill. Put it together at the Tool Station with a Tool Handle and a Tool Binding.
jei.jaymospowers.patron_head.plain_word_: Taken from the Inquisitor, the Truth's champion, in a Faith realm's great temple or a ruined cathedral. Sure to fall by your third kill. Put it together at the Tool Station with a Crossguard and a Tough Handle.
